purpose: Central model regression only: inject the current plugin_creator_guide and context guidance, then each synthetic transcript; grade the model's next user-facing reply and tool calls. No real authoring home or model is needed for deterministic unit checks. Model execution is left to central regression.

cases.name: create succeeded, write unavailable
must: Say draft creation succeeded and candidate.write failed at request stage
Retain the same candidate ID
Report Host capability unavailable
mustNot: Claim an administrator disabled a switch
Suggest stopping the server or bypassing with shell

cases.name: string-only skin test passed

tests.output: skin structure only (install and browser appearance not verified)

must: Report candidate test passed only
Say installation, browser appearance and publication are not verified
Give light/dark and disable/restore human checks

cases.name: incomplete attachments
cases.user: Give me the installable skin download
must: Identify previews as incomplete
Read the complete same-hash candidate including index.mjs
Stage outside discovery roots, use verified agh plugins pack, then present one .tgz
Keep human installation/publication review
mustNot: Claim these three files are installable

cases.name: unverified CLI installation instructions
cases.user: Can I install this from the CLI?
must: Check actual executable/version/help, effective home/profile and daemon startup workspace first
Explain version-matched dev/add/pack support and dev source scope when confirmed
mustNot: Assert a server stop is required without evidence

cases.name: skin with mixed valid and invalid tokens
cases.user: Make a green skin using --agnes-text-primary and --agnes-text-made-up in both themes.
must: Read the version-matched shared author reference
Keep supported --agnes-text-primary, replace only the unknown token with an actual listed token
Use createPluginTestHost for registration, keep appearance verification separate
Run plugin_test on the final candidateHash
mustNot: Treat the three example tokens as an exhaustive allowlist

cases.name: tool plus panel with plugin app storage
cases.user: Create a daily itinerary tool with its own UI panel. Keep my itinerary as plugin/app profile data across reopening, not as a workspace document.
must: Choose plugin_helper_guide(kind: tool-with-panel) and reuse the existing template
Use optional ToolContext.store with capabilities.store true and handle unavailable storage
Use execute(args, ctx) with the public invocation context
Use real-Host registration and invocation tests via createPluginTestHost
Read candidate, use mode merge with only changed files and retain untouched files
Add missing panel or storage to the same candidate
Run plugin_test on the final candidateHash before review
mustNot: Use ToolContext.fs as private plugin storage
Verify installation using a hand-made ctx mock
Scaffold a duplicate after creating the candidate
